shared_elements: low-relief carving on an upright slab/stela with rounded top
row of repeated small signs/motifs in a band
justification: Both are upright relief slabs organized into stacked horizontal registers, with animal and anthropomorphic figures shown in profile and a band of small repeated signs, and both include a bird in profile and a figure with arms raised/extended. But the specific content differs sharply: A shows repeated three-dimensional crouching quadrupeds along the top, a large predatory quadruped over a small squatting human, and a large long-necked bird, all schematic and without text, whereas B shows two facing human figures flanking an offering stand in a single scene above several lines of dense pictographic script, a formal, proportioned, text-and-scene convention absent from A.
